_comment: What the storefront sells when NEXT_PUBLIC_CLUSTER=devnet. This one pool is OpenGacha's public devnet demo: a hundred fake cards backed with devnet SOL, so anyone can pull, keep, take the buyback, deposit and withdraw without spending anything real. Get devnet SOL at https://faucet.solana.com and put your wallet in testnet mode. Replace it with your own devnet pool when you are testing your own.

pools.name: Devnet demo pack
pools.tagline: A hundred fake cards, backed in devnet SOL. Pull one, keep it or take the buyback, deposit one of your own. Nothing here costs real money.
